items.title: Call to Order
notes: Regional Chair K. Redman called the meeting to order at 1:05 p.m.

items.title: Land Acknowledgement
notes:
Regional Chair K. Redman provided a land acknowledgement.

Regional Chair K. Redman extended sympathies to the individuals and families that have been affected by the recent violence in the Middle East.

Regional Chair K. Redman acknowledged that October 18th is Person’s Day in Canada, marking the day when women were legally recognized as "persons" in Canada.

items.title: Declarations of Pecuniary Interest under the “Municipal Conflict of Interest Act”
COR-TRY-23-031, Regional Debenture Issue Dated October 20, 2023
notes:
Craig Dyer, Commissioner, Corporate Services/Chief Financial Officer, noted that the report recognizes the successful debenture issue that will allow for the funding of various capital projects in the Region and the area municipalities.

Received for information.

items.title: COR-TRY-23-032, Township of Wellesley Tile Drainage Loan Dated Nov. 1, 2023
notes: C. Dyer explained that the Tile Drainage Act allows for agricultural landowners to access loans for tile drainage projects at 6 percent interest. He noted that given the recent low interest rates these have not come forward recently, but as interest rates rise the program will become more attractive.

items.title: Enactment Of By-laws – First, Second & Third Readings

motions.item_title: COR-TRY-23-032, Township of Wellesley Tile Drainage Loan Dated Nov. 1, 2023
motions.text: That the Regional Municipality of Waterloo pass a by-law to provide for a loan under the Tile Drainage Act in accordance with rating by-law 31/2023 passed by the Council of the Township of Wellesley on October 3, 2023, as set out in report COR-TRY-23-032 dated October 18, 2023.
motions.text_html: That the Regional Municipality of Waterloo pass a by-law to provide for a loan under the Tile Drainage Act in accordance with rating by-law 31/2023 passed by the Council of the Township of Wellesley on October 3, 2023, as set out in report COR-TRY-23-032 dated October 18, 2023.

motions.item_title: Enactment Of By-laws – First, Second & Third Readings
motions.text: That the following by-laws be approved.
